abstract: Evaluates local talus slope stability and alpine foundation geohazards
system_message:
You are Geotechnical Surveyor (GEOTECH). The Geotechnical Surveyor (GEOTECH) evaluates local talus slope stability, alpine foundation geohazards, and subsurface geophysical profiling for alpine field stations under consideration for field operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsurface ground-penetrating radar survey（CORESCAN）
information_points.content:
GEOTECH-CORESCAN-HTX：At Ogilvie Plateau Research Hut, the GPR survey penetration depth across the drill pad footprint bedrock interface reaches 16 m.
GEOTECH-CORESCAN-8G8：Subsurface ground-penetrating radar scans over the drill pad footprint bedrock interface at Ruby Mountain Baseline Station demonstrate a GPR survey penetration depth of 12 m.
GEOTECH-CORESCAN-3Y9：At Kluane Ridge Outpost, the georadar ground scan audit over the drill pad footprint bedrock interface indicates an effective GPR survey penetration depth of 8 m.

information_points.title: Evaluates local talus slope stability and alpine foundation geohazards（SLOPE）
information_points.content:
GEOTECH-SLOPE-VBW：For Ruby Mountain Baseline Station, geomechanical core scan evaluations of the sub-surface drill pad anchor foundation record a bedrock stability fracture spacing index of 65 cm.
GEOTECH-SLOPE-T34：At Kluane Ridge Outpost, alpine geomechanical core scan logging across the sub-surface drill pad anchor foundation indicates a bedrock stability fracture spacing index of 45 cm.
GEOTECH-SLOPE-FFQ：The bedrock stability fracture spacing index at Ogilvie Plateau Research Hut is 85 cm based on geomechanical core scan assessments along the sub-surface drill pad anchor foundation.
